jobs.summary_note: An eight-week summer analyst internship in economic consulting, working on case teams with academic experts, senior consultants and analysts. The work includes economic and financial modelling, cleaning and analysing large datasets, examining markets and industries, reviewing academic research and presenting findings. The opportunity is aimed at penultimate-year students expecting to graduate between December 2027 and June 2028, with strong academic and analytical backgrounds and an interest in business and economics.

jobs.summary_note: A senior technology consulting role focused on designing Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions for complex finance transformation programmes. Responsibilities include architecture across consolidation, planning, budgeting, tax reporting and enterprise data management, alongside integration design, finance data and reporting models, and technical governance. The role requires deep Oracle EPM architecture experience and a strong record in enterprise integration and finance data challenges. It is based in Ireland on a hybrid basis, with travel as required, and visa sponsorship is available.
